(☉ㅅ☉U) |[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 27 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Rusher''' was an extremely fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. Although it has low health, it holds a shield and moves extremely fast, being faster than every enemy currently in the game. This makes it a very dangerous threat if you do not have the right towers. It will lose its shield when all of its shield health has depleted, making it run at a fast pace. ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Rusher's''' appearance is similar to the [[Rusher (Polluted Wasteland)|Rusher]] enemy from [[Polluted Wasteland]] and Legacy [[Fallen]]. It has black reflective skin and granite, dark turquoise torso and legs. It wears a mask with purple neon parts, a chestplate with purple parts, and black and neon purple armbands. It also has black boots, gloves and knee-pads. While running, it holds up a shield in front of it with its left arm. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Destroy the '''Fallen Rusher's''' shield to slow it down as soon as possible. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]] and [[Engineer]], can deal with these [[enemies]] quickly. **The [[Commander]] can boost the firerate of towers, making it easier to deal with '''Fallen Rushers'''. **The [[Accelerator]] is also recommended, however be aware that the '''Fallen Rusher''' may outrun its charge-up time if placed in a bad spot. *[[Military Base]] vehicles, [[Elf Camp]]'s units and [[Crook Boss]] minions can be useful against the '''Fallen Rusher''' if it gets past your towers. *The [[Toxic Gunner]] can be useful to slow down these enemies to a slower and more manageable speed for a few seconds. *As they have average size, the [[Electroshocker]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]] can stop the '''Fallen Rusher'''. **The [[Sledger]] is generally not recommended against this, as the '''Fallen Rusher''' can easily avoid being hit by it due to its slow firerate and low range. *A Level 5 [[Golden Pyromancer]] can easily break the shields of a horde of '''Fallen Rushers'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} FallenRusherNoShieldV1.png|First version, first animation, without shield variant (28 August 2020 - 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFallenRusher.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, with shield variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseLegacyFallenRusherNoShield.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, no shield variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseLegacyFallenRusherNoShield2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second no shield variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Rusher''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer 2020|'''Fallen Rusher''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexLFallenRusher.png|'''Fallen Rusher''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Fallen Rusher''' is the fallen version of the [[Rusher]], but significantly weaker. *A new version of the '''Fallen Rusher''' was added to [[Fallen Mode]]. *This is the second fastest enemy in the game when it has its shield, with the [[Imposter]] being faster. **The speed of the '''Fallen Rusher''' is nearly the same as the player walk speed, having a speed of 15 while the player has a speed of 16. *The '''Fallen Rusher''' uses a similar shield to the legacy [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]. *The '''Fallen Rusher''' used a regular walking animation when it did not have its shield during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. **It now uses a similar animation to the [[Fallen]] when it loses its shield. *The sound effect that plays when the '''Fallen Rusher''' loses its shield is a lower pitched version of the sound effect of the [[Lead Boss]] losing its covering. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' -
